'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Robert Smolarek LS Yavin 4 Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Robert Smolarek]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robert Smolarek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4 Operations / The Time To Fight Is Now]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
